name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 6 visits over 21 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 16 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 21 hours starting 2025-06-06, at wavelengths from 1.02 to 4.68 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
